page.p.ug_speaks_the_languages.text: UG speaks the languages of Uganda, of the region, and of its visitors. Pick yours; everything follows.

position.text: Look the part. Pay the smart price.

top.p.one_app_that_quotes.text: One app that quotes every ride on the Ugandan market side by side, pools the road trip so the Prado costs a quarter, rents the car when you need to arrive, and books the park before the permits go. Paid the way Kampala pays: mobile money.

compare.summary.more_options_pick_the.text: More options <small>pick the car, rain, split</small>

compare.p.book_on_ug_where.text: Book on UG where a channel exists, Call ahead where it does not, Listed for recognition, Coming for what is being built. Fares are modelled and say so.

quality.h2.what_each_operator_has.text: What each operator has promised, in writing. That is all this board can honestly show you today.

quality.p.rating_other_people_s.text: Rating other people's companies is easy to do badly. A score printed next to a registered name is a claim about that business, and UG has not run enough trips to make one. So this board shows what each operator has published — the fare table, the helmet, the receipt — and where we read it. The performance column stays empty until the trips behind it are ours. Below, the same arithmetic runs on four operators we invented, so you can check the method before it is ever pointed at a real name.

quality.summary.the_arithmetic_demonstra.text: The arithmetic, demonstrated <small>four invented operators, so the method can be checked before it touches a real name</small>

quality.p.operators_a_to_e.text: Operators A to E do not exist. Their figures are written by UG so that every rule on this page can be watched doing its work: one that keeps its word and has the trips to prove it; one that is steady but slow to put things right; one that keeps the fare and is chronically late, held at Watch by a safety breach whatever the rest says; one that always turns up, argues about money afterwards and has published almost nothing, so the ceiling holds it down; and one whose numbers are excellent on eighteen trips, pulled back toward the market baseline because eighteen trips is not a record.

quality.li.the_brand_and_how.text: The brand, and how long it has existed

quality.li.how_big_the_fleet.text: How big the fleet is, or how much it raised

quality.li.money_paid_to_ug.text: Money paid to UG by a supplier for position — there is no such payment and no way to make one. UG's own commission, ten percent on a pooled seat, is charged to the rider and never to a supplier for placement

quality.li.how_much_it_advertises.text: How much it advertises, here or anywhere

quality.li.whether_it_has_a.text: Whether it has a press office to publish promises with — which is why this board is not ranked by the promise count

stage.div.the_virtual_stage_seats.text: The Virtual Stage · seats fill first, then the car comes

stage.h2.pay_for_the_seat.text: Pay for the seat. The car comes when it fills.

stage.p.like_a_matatu_stage.text: Like a matatu stage, a car leaves when it is full or at the cut-off. Unlike a stage, you queue money from your sofa, the seat price falls as friends join, and the driver who takes it already said they are comfortable on that road.

stage.summary.where_stages_fill_fastest.text: Where stages fill fastest <small>Pulse · paid seats against comfort maps, by town</small>

stage.summary.buses_on_this_corridor.text: Buses on this corridor <small>the fallback, side by side with the stage</small>

stage.p.every_corridor_also_has.text: Every corridor also has buses. Compare departure times across operators, see the park you leave from, and book on UG where the operator takes online bookings. Where it does not, we say so and give you the number to call ahead, rather than a dead button.

stage.summary.empty_legs_the_return.text: Empty legs <small>the return seats, 40% of the fare</small>

stage.p.every_rental_with_driver.text: Every rental with driver and every pool has a way back. The moment the outbound is booked, the return's seats go on sale.

stage.summary.post_a_trip_of.text: Post a trip of your own, or price a seat <small>Pool · your circles, the true cost of the road divided by seats</small>

stage.h3.offer_a_seat_or.text: Offer a seat, or see what a seat should cost

stage.p.posted_trips_live_only.text: Posted trips live only in this browser until you sign in. Pool follows the same pattern the Pool app popularised: phone-verified accounts, a trip chat, and two-way ratings, plus circles so you ride with people you already half-know.

rent.h2.rent_the_car_or.text: Self-drive by the day. Chauffeured by the hour.

rent.p.self_drive_by_the.text: Self-drive by the day, chauffeured by the hour, or the Signature fleet when the arrival is the point. The price is per head when you split it.

deliver.h2.send_the_thing_any.text: Send the thing. Any size, any distance.

deliver.p.every_courier_in_town.text: Every courier in town on one screen, ranked. Upcountry, the parcel rides in the boot of a stage car for a quarter of a seat, and in harvest season a minibus, pickup or lorry with a driver.

deliver.p.courier_rates_are_ug.text: Courier rates are UG estimates from a published model; 8 to 8 in Jinja is named from the founder's brief and its tariff is modelled. Parcel on the Stage is UG's own price: a quarter of the seat on that stage, paid to the driver with the seats.

explore.h2.the_whole_park_weekend.text: The whole park weekend, one number.

explore.p.park_entry_permits_vehicle.text: Park entry, permits, vehicle fees, the lodge, the rolex money and the road there, computed for East African citizens, foreign residents and visitors. East African citizens pay East African prices.

explore.summary.chain_a_whole_day.text: Chain a whole day <small>Hustle Mode · every leg quoted on the cheapest sensible mode; wallet and plans are sandbox</small>

explore.div.ug_wallet_sandbox_balance.text: UG Wallet · sandbox balance, not real money

drive.h2.say_where_you_are.text: Say where you are comfortable, once. Accept full cars.

drive.p.no_posting_no_waiting.text: No posting, no waiting at a stage, no bidding. Your Comfort Map is the only thing you maintain: base, radius, corridors, hours, hard no’s. Funded offers arrive with the money already in them.

drive.summary.where_demand_is_coming.text: Where demand is coming this week <small>Foresight · harvests, venue rhythms and events, a week ahead, by vehicle class</small>

drive.p.promise_to_be_there.text: Promise to be there and the gap closes for everyone. Confidence is shown per signal; seasons are rules until the first harvest teaches them.

drive.span.confidence_is_shown_per.text: Confidence is shown per signal; seasons are rules until there are fills to learn from.

install.h2.the_site_is_the.text: The site is the app. Install it, or scan the code.

install.p.one_link_on_the.text: One link on the web and on the phone: the same account, the same stages, the same Crest on the home screen. No store visit.

install.p.scan_with_the_camera.text: Scan with the camera. The code opens this same link; sign in with the same number and everything is here.

install.p.ride_pool_rent_deliver.text: Ride. Pool. Rent. Deliver. A Ugandan mobility marketplace for people who have places to be and a budget to respect.

railModal.span.booked_and_tracked_on.text: Booked and tracked on UG. The concierge is simulated in this prototype.

railModal.div.reduce_motionno_opening_an.text: Reduce motionNo opening animation, no drifting particles, no reveals

railModal.div.underline_linksevery_link_.text: Underline linksEvery link underlined, not colour alone

railModal.p.ug_also_follows_your.text: UG also follows your system settings for reduced motion and contrast, works with a screen reader (landmarks, labels and live regions), is keyboard-navigable end to end, and listens to voice commands through the microphone button or a Cephable profile. Tell us what would help: hello@ug.example.

ops.p.every_town_on_the.text: Every town on the map is a corridor from Kampala and a stage of its own. Where a local app already runs, UG hands the last mile to it rather than pretending to be there.

ops.div.plug_ins_ug_talks.text: Plug-ins · UG talks to the tools you already use

ops.h2.maps_from_felt_climate.text: Maps from Felt. Climate workflows from Infrared City. Entertainment from Tazama. Hands-free control from Cephable.

ops.p.each_plug_in_is.text: Each plug-in is an adapter with its own endpoint and key, stored on this device until you sign in. Connect one and the matching buttons light up across Pool, Explore and Hustle Mode. Nothing leaves UG without a plug-in you switched on.

ops.h2.competitors_are_listed_on.text: Competitors are listed on purpose. A rider who trusts the comparison comes back for the pool and the rental.

ops.p.ug_is_a_marketplace.text: UG is a marketplace first. Ride-hailing apps get pre-filled bookings with no acquisition cost. Rental yards get vetted weekend renters. Lodges get groups arriving on a known date. Drivers get a route full before they leave.

ops.p.verified_drivers_and_plates.text: Verified drivers and plates, an in-trip SOS that shares live location with a contact you choose, helmets on every pooled boda, and a receipt for every shilling.

ops.p.ten_percent_on_pool.text: Ten percent on pool, a flat listing fee on rentals, weekly payouts to MoMo through Flutterwave, and demand you did not have to advertise for.

ops.p.deep_links_that_open.text: Deep links that open your app with pick-up and drop-off filled. We never show a price we did not compute openly, and the method is published.

ui.reviewNote.text: UG wrote these translations and a second pass checked them; native-speaker review is open. Missing words fall back to English.

langNote.text: Anything a native speaker has not checked yet falls back to English where a word is missing. Help us finish yours.

compare.p.bolt_safeboda_faras_yango.text: Bolt, SafeBoda, Faras, Yango, Tinka, the street boda, the matatu, a special hire, the bus, the ferry, the flight, and UG’s own pool and rentals. Same trip, same minute. Estimates say so on the card, and the ones that cannot serve you stay on the screen, greyed, with the reason. UG takes payment only for its own seats and cars; every other row shows you the fare and opens that operator's app, because we will not take your money for a ride we have no contract to place.

railModal.div.the_day.text: The dayThe page keeps Kampala's hours. On the equator the sun is up at 06:54 and down at 18:54 all year, so the palette walks black → red → gold → red → black and never hands you a white page at one in the morning. Weather bends it: cloud flattens the light, rain cools it toward the crane's grey-blue.

rent.p.the_price_is_shown.text: The price is per head as well as per day, because in Kampala the Prado is a group decision.

stage.p.someone_in_your_circle.text: Someone in your circle is already driving. No surge, no meter, no awkward cash — the fare is the true cost of the road, divided by the seats.

explore.p.for_people_running_three.text: For people running three lives. UG quotes each leg on the cheapest sensible mode, and says where a boda is faster than your dignity is worth.
